title: 冒雨来的客人  (In from the Rain)

segments.t: Down in the lobby, soft-spoken traveller Hao steps inside shaking water off his umbrella. Qing greets him at the front desk while Mei brings over a dry towel. Listen first.
晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
哦？我的预订有问题吗？
我们不小心给今晚的七号房登记了两位客人。
啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
'Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.'
晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
'Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.'
没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
'No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?'
是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
'Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.'
先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
'Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.'
热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
'Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.'
先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
'Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.'
哦？我的预订有问题吗？
'Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?'
我们不小心给今晚的七号房登记了两位客人。
'We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.'
啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
'Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.'
请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
'Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.'
阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
'An attic study? May I go up and see it first?'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

Honesty, a dry towel, and a bowl of hot soup kept everything calm and warm. Next time, Hao climbs the stairs to judge the attic study for himself. See you next time.
回头见！
